thread:
sophia: FYI - seeing memory spike on embeddings-service in prod -> intermittent 503s for some hosted tenants. I have a candidate hotfix (cherry-pick abc123) that reduces KV cache allocation. Requesting expedited deploy + canary pin. Need ops + release approval now. :rotating_light:

tarun (oncall): How widespread? which region?

sophia: Primarily us-west1 and eu-west1, around 0.7% request errors over last 15m. p50 gen latency up ~40ms. Noting it's customer-facing errors for batch embedding jobs.

mike: Can we do a partial canary (5%) and monitor for 10m? If green, 25% -> 100% on short window. Also want a pinned version in case we need to fallback.

sophia: Agreed. Plan: deploy v1.2.8-canary -> 5% traffic, smoke, then 25/100. Rollback criteria: error rate > 0.3% OR p50 > baseline+25ms. Pin older version v1.2.7 for quick rollback.

adele: Product note - we've got a small set of paying tenants hitting errors. We should call out in release notes that this is an urgent fix for embeddings memory. Also want support on messaging if we expand.

leo: Security check - does the hotfix change any env or secrets?

sophia: No env/secrets changes. It's a small allocator change inside the model-serving process. CI passed.

opsbot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-mem-leak

deploy-bot: Deploy requested by sophia: deploy embeddings-service:v1.2.8-canary -> staging: SUCCESS, scheduled to prod canary 5% at 21:34 PT. Command: ```helm upgrade --install embeddings redwood/embeddings --reuse-values --set image.tag=v1.2.8-canary --set traffic.canary=0.05 --namespace prod```

tarun (oncall): Approve expedited? I can cut smoke checks and watch errorrate.

mike: +1 from eng-releases. I can be on standby to rollback artifacts and pin routes.

adele: +1 from product, please include quick release notes: "hotfix: fix memory allocation for embeddings; reduces 503s for long-running batch requests"

leo: +1 from security (no creds impact).

release-bot: Expedited deploy policy: auto-approve granted for severity >= P1 after 3 approvers from {eng, oncall, product}. Audit: ticket #RWD-5472 linked.

opsbot: Canary monitor: prometheus query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embeddings",status!~"2.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embeddings"}[5m]))` -> alert if > 0.003

mike: Reminder: pin the canary in the console so Dedicated pools keep using older images until we flip. Quick command to pin: ```curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/v1/pins -d '{"service":"embeddings","version":"v1.2.7","reason":"hotfix rollback pin"}'```

sophia: Deploying canary now. tarun please run smoke script and ack.

tarun (oncall): Running smoke now -> `./scripts/smoke_embeddings.sh --rate=10 --duration=5m`

20:21: deploy-bot: prod canary rollout started: embeddings v1.2.8-canary -> 5% (deploy-id: db-4311122-14).

tarun (oncall): Smoke finished: 0.08% errors (baseline 0.35%), p50 latency down 15ms. No OOMs observed.

mike: Looks good. Increase to 25% in 2m, will monitor.

sophia: Increasing to 25% now.

20:25: deploy-bot: rollout progressed: 25% -> monitoring window.

adele: Notifying support for messaging.

20:29: deploy-bot: rollout completed to 100% in prod. embeddings v1.2.8 tagged.
notes: release notes: hotfix v1.2.8 - fix memory allocation for embeddings; cherry-pick abc123; expedited deploy approved by tarun, mike, adele; rollback pinned to v1.2.7 if alerts triggered. canary 5%->25%->100% with defined error/p50 thresholds. commands included for helm and pinning.
